get.description:
Returns a list of all careers with data corresponding to the geographical area(s) specified.
There are five query keys that you can pass: `category`, `pathway`, `moc`, `fields`, `onets`. The `category`, `pathway`, `moc` and `onets` keys cannot be used together.
The `fields` key is always required as there is no default return object.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description:
A comma-separated array of individual career fields.
Must be one or more of `abilities`, `age`, `annual-earnings`, `annual-openings`, `categories`, `core-tasks`, `description`, `education-attainment-levels`, `employment`, `employment-current`, `hourly-earnings`, `humanized-title`, `knowledge`, `lay-titles`, `median-earnings`, `mocs`, `national-lq`, `onet-id`, `pathways`, `percent-female`, `percent-male`, `plural-short-title`, `short-title`, `similar-occs`, `singular-title`, `skills`, `soc-id`, `soc-title`, `title`, `title-slug`, `typical-ed-level`.

parameters.name: onets
parameters.description: a subset of specific [O*NET IDs](https://www.onetcenter.org/taxonomy.html) to filter the careers list by. Unrecognized O*NET IDs will be skipped. If no O*NET IDs are recognized, an empty array is returned.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: filter careers by one of the categories.

parameters.name: pathway
parameters.description: filter careers by one of the pathways.

parameters.name: moc
parameters.description: a modified moc code that includes the military branch and status as a prefix.

parameters.name: datarun
parameters.description: Parameter used to indicate which datarun version to query during transitionary periods when multiple dataruns are being supported. Currently, the only datarun supported is 2025_1.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: (for pagination); The number of results to skip over. For instance, `?offset=5` means the first 5 results would be omitted.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: (for pagination); The total number of results to return. For instance, `?limit=10 means` the result set is limited to 10 results. Used in conjunction with `offset`, you can slice the result set, e.g. `?offset=20&limit=10` would give you results 21-31.

parameters.name: level
parameters.description: type of geographic regional division. Valid level options are `nation`, `county`, `state`, `zip`, and `msa`.

parameters.name: geoId
parameters.description: geographical identifier associated with a specific area. Can be a single id, or comma-delimited string of ids

post.description:
This query is identical to the `GET` query above except that you `POST` the geoids in a json array rather than appending them to the querystring. This should only be used
if you have too many areas and/or ONET codes to fit into a query string.
Returns a list of all careers with data corresponding to the geographical area(s) specified.
There are five query keys that you can pass: `category`, `pathway`, `moc`, `fields`, `onets`. The `category`, `pathway`, `moc` and `onets` keys cannot be used together.
The `fields` key is always required as there is no default return object.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description:
A comma-separated array of individual career fields.
Must be one or more of `abilities`, `age`, `annual-earnings`, `annual-openings`, `categories`, `core-tasks`, `description`, `education-attainment-levels`, `employment`, `employment-current`, `hourly-earnings`, `humanized-title`, `knowledge`, `lay-titles`, `median-earnings`, `mocs`, `national-lq`, `onet-id`, `pathways`, `percent-female`, `percent-male`, `plural-short-title`, `short-title`, `similar-occs`, `singular-title`, `skills`, `soc-id`, `soc-title`, `title`, `title-slug`, `typical-ed-level`.

parameters.name: onets
parameters.description: a subset of specific [O*NET IDs](https://www.onetcenter.org/taxonomy.html) to filter the careers list by. Unrecognized O*NET IDs will be skipped. If no O*NET IDs are recognized, an empty array is returned.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: filter careers by one of the categories.

parameters.name: pathway
parameters.description: filter careers by one of the pathways.

parameters.name: moc
parameters.description: a modified moc code that includes the military branch and status as a prefix.

parameters.name: datarun
parameters.description: Parameter used to indicate which datarun version to query during transitionary periods when multiple dataruns are being supported. Currently, the only datarun supported is 2025_1.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: (for pagination); The number of results to skip over. For instance, `?offset=5` means the first 5 results would be omitted.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: (for pagination); The total number of results to return. For instance, `?limit=10 means` the result set is limited to 10 results. Used in conjunction with `offset`, you can slice the result set, e.g. `?offset=20&limit=10` would give you results 21-31.

parameters.name: level
parameters.description: type of geographic regional division. Valid level options are `nation`, `county`, `state`, `zip`, and `msa`.

core-tasks: Direct or coordinate an organization's financial or budget activities to fund operations, maximize investments, or increase efficiency.
Appoint department heads or managers and assign or delegate responsibilities to them.
Analyze operations to evaluate performance of a company or its staff in meeting objectives or to determine areas of potential cost reduction, program improvement, or policy change.
Direct, plan, or implement policies, objectives, or activities of organizations or businesses to ensure continuing operations, to maximize returns on investments, or to increase productivity.
Confer with board members, organization officials, or staff members to discuss issues, coordinate activities, or resolve problems.
Prepare budgets for approval, including those for funding or implementation of programs.
Implement corrective action plans to solve organizational or departmental problems.

Direct human resources activities, including the approval of human resource plans or activities, the selection of directors or other high-level staff, or establishment or organization of major departments.
Negotiate or approve contracts or agreements with suppliers, distributors, federal or state agencies, or other organizational entities.
Preside over, or serve on, boards of directors, management committees, or other governing boards.
Establish departmental responsibilities and coordinate functions among departments and sites.
Coordinate the development or implementation of budgetary control systems, recordkeeping systems, or other administrative control processes.
Review reports submitted by staff members to recommend approval or to suggest changes.
Deliver speeches, write articles, or present information at meetings or conventions to promote services, exchange ideas, or accomplish objectives.
Interpret and explain policies, rules, regulations, or laws to organizations, government or corporate officials, or individuals.
Prepare or present reports concerning activities, expenses, budgets, government statutes or rulings, or other items affecting businesses or program services.
Administer programs for selection of sites, construction of buildings, or provision of equipment or supplies.
Review and analyze legislation, laws, or public policy and recommend changes to promote or support interests of the general population or special groups.
Direct or conduct studies or research on issues affecting areas of responsibility.
attributes.description: Determine and formulate policies and provide overall direction of companies or private and public sector organizations within guidelines set up by a board of directors or similar governing body. post.description:
Uploads regions data from an Excel workbook to the Careers API.

**Geo Levels:**
  - The first row of your Excel sheet must contain geo levels as column headers:
  1. `zip`
  2. `county`
  3. `msa`
  4. `state`
  5. `nation`

**Geo Values:**
  - Below each column header, enter relevant values.
  - Leave cells blank as needed. Only entered values will be added.

**Example Format:**
  ```
  | zip   | county | msa   | state | nation |
  |-------|--------|-------|-------|--------|
  | 83843 | 16057  | 34140 | 16    | 0      |
  | 83844 |        |       |       |        |
  | 99163 |        |       |       |        |
  | 99164 |        |       |       |        |
  ```

```har
  {
    "method": "POST",
    "url": "https://cc.emsiservices.com/careers/us/regions/upload/demo",
    "show": true,
    "headers": [
      {
        "name": "Authorization",
        "value": "Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN>"
      }

  }
```

attributes.description: The Funeral Services Occupation Group includes occupations involved in the business of funeral rites. These roles often entail the embalming and burial or cremation of the dead, as well as the arrangement of funeral ceremonies.

attributes.description: The Pet and Animal Care Occupation Group includes occupations involved in the care, training and treatment of pets, animals and working animals.
attributes.name: Pet and Animal Care

attributes.description: The Stylists and Cosmetologists Occupation Group includes occupations involved in the application of beauty treatment. Roles may include hairstyling, skin care, cosmetics, manicures/pedicures, non-permanent and permanent hair removal.
attributes.name: Stylists and Cosmetologists

attributes.description: The Client Support and Sales Occupation Group includes account representative, executive, and manager occupations which liaison between companies and their customers. Roles are responsible for addressing customers' needs and concerns as quickly and effectively as possible to develop and maintain strong relationships and product implementation.
attributes.name: Account Managers and Executives

attributes.description: The Energy Sales Occupation Group includes occupations specific to the sale of fuel or energy through a variety of methods including target marketing, competitive analysis, and providing value-added energy products, services, and recommendations.
attributes.name: Energy Sales

attributes.description: The Merchandising Occupation Group includes occupations specific to the promotion of goods or services for retail sale, including marketing strategies, display design, and discount offers.
attributes.name: Merchandising

attributes.description: The Non-Technical Sales Occupation Group includes occupations specific to the sale of non-technical goods and services to retail, wholesale, commercial, industrial, professional, and other clients domestically and internationally.
attributes.name: Non-Technical Sales

attributes.description: The Promotional / Commercial Modeling Occupation Group includes occupations involving posing for artistic photo shoots and adorn clothing and accessories during runway shows. High-fashion models display fashion designs in magazine editorials, and they serve as spokespeople to represent brands.
attributes.name: Promotional / Commercial Modeling

attributes.description: The Retail Managers Occupation Group includes managerial occupations specific to the day-to-day operations of a retail store. It includes shop floor supervisors, shift managers and department managers.
attributes.name: Retail Managers

attributes.description: The Retail Sales and Service Occupation Group includes operational occupations that are responsible for the day-to-day workings of a retail outlet or store. It includes greeters, fuel pump attendants and store clerks.
attributes.name: Retail Sales and Service

attributes.description: The Sales Managers Occupation Group includes managerial occupations specific to sales. Roles include managers overseeing any transactions where money or value is exchanged for the ownership of a good or entitlement to a service.
attributes.name: Sales Managers

attributes.description: The Technical Sales Occupation Group includes occupations specific to selling technical or scientific products for an organization. It includes medical, pharmaceutical, software sales and sales engineering roles.
attributes.name: Technical Sales

attributes.description: The Biological Science Occupation Group includes occupations in science or research with a particular focus on biology. This involves the study of life on Earth, whether it is an individual cell, a multicellular organism, or a community of interacting populations. It includes specific areas of focus, such as biochemistry, biophysics, and computational biology, as well as disciplines such as zoology, botany, or genetics.
attributes.name: Biological Science

attributes.description: The Chemical and Physical Science Occupation Group includes occupations in science or research with a particular focus on chemistry or physics. It includes many specific chemist roles, as well as physicists, geophysicists, and astronomers.
attributes.name: Chemical and Physical Science

attributes.description: The Environmental and Climate Science Occupation Group includes occupations in science or research with a particular focus on environmental science and the study of the weather and climate. It also includes geologists and hydrologists.
attributes.name: Environmental and Climate Science

attributes.description: The General Research Occupation Group includes research occupations with non-specific focus, or multidisciplinary focus. It also includes social science researchers, historians, and archeologists.
attributes.name: General Research

attributes.description: The Health and Medical Research Occupation Group includes occupations in medical science or clinical research. It includes epidemiologists, toxicologists, pharmacology researchers, along with drug formulation and drug safety roles.
attributes.name: Health and Medical Research

attributes.description: The Scientific Technicians Occupation Group includes occupations involving working as a member of support staff in any science discipline.
attributes.name: Scientific Technicians

attributes.description: The Policy Analysis Occupation Group includes occupations specific to the examination and evaluation of available options to implement a set of goals - Goals that include improvement in a public setting, such as health or education, but also fiscal goals or enactment of legislation. The process is also used in the administration of large organizations with complex policies.
attributes.name: Policy Analysis

attributes.description: The Social Analysis Occupation Group includes occupations in research with a particular focus on social sciences and economics. It includes security analysts, survey researchers and industrial organizational psychologists.
attributes.name: Social Analysis

attributes.description: The Urban / Transportation Planning Occupation Group includes occupations focused on the development and design of land use in the built environment, including air, water, and the infrastructure passing into and out of urban areas, such as transportation, communications, and distribution networks and their accessibility.
attributes.name: Urban / Transportation Planning

attributes.description: The Air Transportation Occupation Group includes all occupations specific to flying and inspecting aircraft.
attributes.name: Air Transportation

attributes.description: The Delivery Drivers and Messengers Occupation Group includes all occupations specific to delivering messages, goods and food. It includes motorized and non-motorized drivers (i.e. cycle couriers). It includes light truck and van drivers.
attributes.name: Delivery Drivers and Messengers

attributes.description: The Marine Transportation Occupation Group includes all onboard ship and boat occupations - All crew members, such as Boat Captains and Deckhands.
attributes.name: Marine Transportation

attributes.description: The Rail Transportation Occupation Group includes occupations specific to the operations of locomotives and railways for goods or passenger transport.
attributes.name: Rail Transportation

attributes.description: The Taxi Drivers and Valet Workers Occupation Group includes occupations specific to motorized passenger transport in cars or shuttles. It also includes chauffeurs and parking valets.
attributes.name: Taxi Drivers and Valet Workers

attributes.description: The Transportation Operations Occupation Group includes occupations in operational transportation roles, such as air and marine traffic controllers, technicians, and support staff.
attributes.name: Transportation Operations

attributes.description: The Truck and Bus Drivers Occupation Group includes drivers of large or heavy trucks, tankers, dump trucks and flatbed trucks. It also includes bus and coach drivers.
attributes.name: Truck and Bus Drivers

attributes.title: Financial Analysts

attributes.title: Business Teachers, Postsecondary
attributes.description: Teach courses in business administration and management, such as accounting, finance, human resources, labor and industrial relations, marketing, and operations research. attributes.title: Auditors
attributes.description: Examine and analyze accounting records to determine financial status of establishment and prepare financial reports concerning operating procedures.

attributes.title: First-Line Supervisors of Non-Retail Sales Workers
attributes.description: Directly supervise and coordinate activities of sales workers other than retail sales workers. May perform duties such as budgeting, accounting, and personnel work, in addition to supervisory duties.

attributes.title: Explosives Workers, Ordnance Handling Experts, and Blasters

attributes.title: First-Line Supervisors of Office and Administrative Support Workers
attributes.description: Directly supervise and coordinate the activities of clerical and administrative support workers.

attributes.title: Payroll and Timekeeping Clerks

attributes.title: Vocational Education Teachers, Postsecondary
attributes.description: Teach or instruct vocational or occupational subjects at the postsecondary level (but at less than the baccalaureate) to students who have graduated or left high school. Includes correspondence school, industrial, and commercial instructors; and adult education teachers and instructors who prepare persons to operate industrial machinery and equipment and transportation and communications equipment. attributes.title: Secondary School Teachers, Except Special and Career/Technical Education
attributes.description: Teach students in one or more subjects, such as English, mathematics, or social studies at the secondary level in public or private schools. May be designated according to subject matter specialty.

attributes.title: Billing, Cost, and Rate Clerks
attributes.description: Compile data, compute fees and charges, and prepare invoices for billing purposes. Duties include computing costs and calculating rates for goods, services, and shipment of goods; posting data; and keeping other relevant records. attributes.title: Tax Examiners and Collectors, and Revenue Agents
attributes.description: Determine tax liability or collect taxes from individuals or business firms according to prescribed laws and regulations.

attributes.title: Computer, Automated Teller, and Office Machine Repairers
attributes.description: Repair, maintain, or install computers, word processing systems, automated teller machines, and electronic office machines, such as duplicating and fax machines.

attributes.title: Tutors
attributes.description: Provide non-classroom, academic instruction to students on an individual or small-group basis for proactive or remedial purposes.

attributes.title: Chief Executives
attributes.description: Determine and formulate policies and provide overall direction of companies or private and public sector organizations within guidelines set up by a board of directors or similar governing body. Plan, direct, or coordinate operational activities at the highest level of management with the help of subordinate executives and staff managers.

get.description:
Returns lot careers based on the `query` param. You can pass in six query parameters:
`query`, `fields`, `searchFields`, `typoTolerance`, `offset` and `limit`.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: The search value, will return an empty array if not provided.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description:
A comma-separated array of individual career fields.
Must be one or more of `core-tasks`, `description`, `lot-id`, `skills`, `title`, `title-slug`. Default: `title`, `description`, `lot-id`.

parameters.name: searchFields
parameters.description: Fields which will be used to search for the specified query. `searchFields` should be dasherised and comma-separated. Valid field values are `title` and `description`.

parameters.name: typoTolerance
parameters.description: Allowable values are 0, 1, and 2, for number of max character edits that can be made. For example: `nuurse` would match for `nurse` with `typoTolerance=1` or `typoTolerance=2` but `nuuurse` would only match for `nurse` with `typoTolerance=2`. Default setting if the parameter is absent from the request is `typoTolerance=2`.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The number of results to skip over. For instance, `?offset=5` means the first 5 results would be omitted.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The total number of results to return. Default: `1000`, max: `1000`. For instance, `?limit=10` means the result set is limited to 10 results. Used in conjunction with `offset`, you can slice the result set, e.g. `?offset=20&limit=10` would give you results 21-30.

parameters.name: datarun
parameters.description: Parameter used to indicate which datarun version to query during transitionary periods when multiple dataruns are being supported. Currently, the only datarun supported is 2025_1.

post.description: This query will create new US LOT pathways, categories, and general collections. A client claim of `scope: cc_careers_operations:CREATE` is required to use this endpoint. The POST body must include `newVersionName` and `lotMappingVersion`. The `newVersionName` will be applied to the names of all the collections. For example, if the `newVersionName` is "7", the new LOT general collection will be named `us_lot_general_v7`.`lotMappingVersion` is the version of LOT used to generate the new collections. The correct LOT `lotMappingVersion` can be found by checking the mappings endpoint of the Classification API and finding a LOT version that has a mapping to Onet. Example: `7.1.0`. Optionally, `blacklistedCareers`, `standardDatarun` and `standardMappingVersion` can be included in the POST body. `blacklistedCareers` is an array of the career codes of LOT occupations to exclude from the collections. `standardDatarun` refers to which standard collection in our Careers database the new LOT version will map to. If not included in the POST body, `standardDatarun` will default to the current default standard US datarun. example: "2025_1". `standardMappingVersion` refers to the version of Onet used for the LOT to Standard mapping. This will default to "2019.1.1" (this will not change very often).
